items.name: Letter of explanation
items.why: The underwriter would like a short explanation of an item in your file.
items.where_to_find: A few sentences in your own words; your LO can help.

items.name: Large deposit explanation and source
items.why: Lenders must document where large deposits came from.
items.where_to_find: Letter plus supporting document (e.g., transfer statement).

items.name: Signed gift letter
items.why: Documents that gifted funds don't need to be repaid.
items.where_to_find: Your LO will provide the form.

items.name: Gift donor's bank statement or transfer proof
Payoff statement for a debt
items.why: Confirms a debt to be paid at or before closing.

items.name: HR contact for verification of employment
items.why: The lender will confirm employment directly.
